description: This file defines a nested class ReadOnlyStream within LogExtentBuilder, which is a specialized read-only stream implementation used for journaling purposes in Orleans. It provides methods for reading, seeking, and copying data from a log extent, with internal mechanisms to compute length and handle read-only constraints.

classes.name: LogExtentBuilder.ReadOnlyStream
classes.description: A read-only stream implementation that interfaces with LogExtentBuilder to provide read and seek capabilities, and enforces read-only constraints.

methods.name: SetBuilder
methods.description: Associates a LogExtentBuilder instance with the stream and initializes its length and position.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the stream's internal state, clearing the builder reference and resetting position and length.

methods.name: ComputeLength
methods.description: Calculates the total length of the stream based on the builder's buffer and entry lengths.

methods.name: GetVarIntWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width in bytes of a variable-length integer based on its value.

methods.name: GetReadOnlyException
methods.description: Returns a NotSupportedException indicating the stream is read-only.
